text:
```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  kani:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install Kani
        run: cargo install kani

      - name: Run Kani verification
        env:
          KANI_LOG: info
        run: cargo kani test -p storage --features kani
```
